examples.english: We wrote the homework before eating
Before the match we wrote the homework.
examples.transliteration: Qabla al mubara nahnu katabna al wajib.

examples.arabic: فهمتُكَ الآن يا سالم، هل طلبتَ لنا قهوة عربية بالهيل قبل أن نبدأ، أم أطلبها أنا مع بعض التمر؟
examples.english: I understand you now, Salem, did you order us Arabic coffee with cardamom before we begin, or should I order it with some dates?
examples.transliteration: Fahimtuka al-aan ya Salim, hal talabta lana qahwah 'arabiyyah bil-hayl qabla an nabda', am atlubuha ana ma'a ba'd at-tamr?
examples.storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

examples.arabic: فكرة ممتازة، لأنني أحتاج حقاً إلى الوضوء بالماء البارد كي أستعيد نشاطي المفقود قبل تناول تلك الشاورما الساخنة.
examples.english: Excellent idea, because I really need to perform ablution with cold water in order to regain my lost energy before eating that hot shawarma.
examples.transliteration: Fikra mumtaza, li-annani ahtaju haqqan ila al-wudu' bil-ma' al-barid kay asta'ida nashati al-mafqud qabla tanawul tilka ash-shawarma as-sakhina.
examples.storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

examples.arabic: كان هذا الموقف يحتاج الى اعداد جيد منها قبل الذهاب
examples.english: This situation required good preparation from her before going
examples.transliteration: Kana hadha al-mawqif yahtaju ila i'dad jayyid minha qabl adh-dhihab

examples.arabic: شعرت مريم ببعض التردد قبل ان تعيد الفستان الى المحل
examples.english: Maryam felt some hesitation before returning the dress to the shop.
examples.transliteration: Sha'arat Maryam bi-ba'd at-taraddud qabl an tu'id al-fustan ila al-mahall.
